summary.text: Edith Ajello is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 1 since 1993, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate.

paragraphs.text: Edith Ajello earned a B.A. from Bucknell University in 1966.

Her professional experience includes serving as interim executive director of Volunteers in Providence Schools in 1993 and as store manager of V. George Rustigian Rugs from 1981 to 1993 and again from 1994 to the present, and she served on the Democratic State Committee from 1993 to 1998.
Ballotpedia lists Ajello as chair of the House Judiciary Committee in the 2011-2012 and 2013-2014 sessions.
She is divorced and has two children, according to Ballotpedia.
